Part 1 高频 物品 OBJECTS

Sports team

运动队 / 团队运动

⚠️ AI 范例，仅供学习 — IELTS 口语全程独立完成，背诵照搬 AI 答案会被考官识别为背稿。

问题与答案

Q1Have you ever been part of a sports team?

No, I haven't, to be honest. I've never really been into competitive sports, so I never joined any team at school. I prefer spending my free time on other things, like gaming or chatting with friends online.

从没加入过运动队，对竞技体育不感兴趣。

Q2Is team sports popular in your culture?

Yeah, I'd say so, especially basketball and football. A lot of my classmates play basketball after school, and the school often holds matches. It's just not really my thing, but I can see why people enjoy it.

团队运动在国内很流行，篮球足球都多人玩，但我不感兴趣。

Q3Do you like watching team games? Why?

Not really, to be honest. Watching team games just doesn't grab my attention, so I rarely sit through a full match. I'd rather watch something more engaging to me, like esports, which I find genuinely exciting.

不喜欢看团队比赛，更爱看电竞。

Q4What are the differences between team sports and individual sports?

The main difference is cooperation. In team sports, everyone has to work together and coordinate, so you win or lose as a group. Individual sports, on the other hand, depend entirely on your own skill and preparation.

区别在于配合，团队运动要协作，个人运动全靠自己。
